add.title: A walk into a referenced child stamps the child's own lines with the writer, not "owner"
add.why: mastermind-page wrote {tasks:{core-page-parts-part-view-and-part-file:{wait:{...}}}} into core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/task.jsonl at 03:14:22Z (by mastermind-page); the child's own log part-types/session.jsonl then got five set lines (state, waiting_on, waiting_what, waiting_since, ran_ms) stamped by "owner" at 03:14:23Z. A reader of that log would think the owner set the wait. Find where a referenced child's Store stamps by (core/Item Store or the item tool's child write) and pass the parent line's by down.

add.title: Item page check 'hydrate survives non-object data and a non-array items value' fails
add.why: Fails on michael/dev and on worktree/class-docs alike (seen 2026-10-28 by build C, headless): Item.hydrate({data: 5, items: 'nope'}) no longer leaves h.items undefined or h.data empty. Item.js is build A's; either the check or hydrate is out of date.

add.title: Route Servex's own raw record writers through record_lines, or let the live root catch up on appended bytes
add.why: Build D (one writer, worktree/one-writer) routed the browser, hooks and LogLine through record_lines, but about 20 Servex/Server files still appendFileSync to task/session/page.jsonl in-process (Agents.open_task, SessionRecord.add_ref, ChildLinks, Sessions, Promote, Subpages, inbox, AIIndex...). Each still makes the next item() call replay the whole file (164 ms on the voice session). Cheapest guard: live_root replays only the bytes appended since its signature when the file only grew (prefix unchanged), so every writer is cheap; then convert the writers one by one.

add.title: Name core/Item/replay in core/Item's children so the Replay Lab page is reachable from the nav
add.why: merge.mjs warns on every core/Item merge (2026-11-02): core/Item/replay has a page.js but its parent does not name it in children:, so it is unreachable from the nav

add.title: Store.remember: hash a live line before replay_line runs (or catch around remember())
add.why: A raw pages.add line appended to a LivePage's page.jsonl was replayed live; replay attached the page tree to the entry, making it circular, and hash_line (core/Item/Store.js:275) threw 'Converting circular structure to JSON' as window.onerror, dropping the rest of the batch. Seen in ai/errors/2026-11-07.jsonl 01:53:33 (reported by mastermind-live-page).

complete.outcome: Store.read hashes each line before replaying it, so a replay that hangs a live object on the line (pages.add gets its Page) no longer throws from JSON.stringify and drops the rest of the batch.
complete.evidence: 4f2f05535 on compliance/dev; Store.test.mjs check 4 (circular replay: no throw, later lines replay, both remembered), 13 checks pass; reset, replay, snapshot and transport tests pass.

add.title: Refuse a card id that names a List property ("store")
add.why: 2026-11-06: content.add with id "store" on /live/session-page/ was accepted and written, but the card never drew and {"content":{"store":…}} is refused ('not an existing card'), because `store` is a List property. The add should refuse the id the way the edit does.
